options: A: 밥과 바비는 블록 쌓기를 자주 했나 봐.
B: 밥은 코끼리 블록을 올릴 때쯤 꼭 재채기를 했나 보네.
C: 밥이 아파서 바비의 아빠가 매우 슬퍼하셨어.
D: 밥은 팔다리를 못 움직이지만, 말은 할 수 있었어.
E: 바비는 밥이 입원한 병원에 가고 싶어 했어.
questions.question:
[지문]
Bob and Bobby often played with old wooden blocks. They slowly piled the blocks one by one to build a tower.

"There is one more block to put," Bob said.
"And that's the elephant block," Bobby said.
Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top. But Bob sneezed, and the tower fell. Bobby laughed and laughed. Bobby said, "You always sneeze when the elephant block appears."

Time passed. One day, Bobby's dad looked very sad. He told Bobby,
"Bob fell ill. He is in a hospital which is far from here."

"I want to see him," Bobby said.
"You can't, Bobby," Mom told him. "He can't move his arms and legs, and he can't talk. We'll just have to wait and hope that he will get better."

다음 글의 내용으로 미루어 볼 때, <보기>의 대화 중 글을 바르게 이해하지 못한 사람은?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 "He can't move his arms and legs, and he can't talk"이라고 명시되어 있으므로, 밥은 팔다리를 못 움직이고 말도 할 수 없다. 따라서 D 선지가 잘못 이해한 것이다.

options: Bob and Bobby used it to mark the end of the game.

questions.question:

Bobby got his name from his grandfather, Bob. Bob was his best friend. Bob was the person who taught Bobby how to walk. "Hold my hands, Bobby," Bob said. "Now one foot, now the other."

Bob and Bobby often played with old wooden blocks. They slowly piled the blocks one by one to build a tower.

"There is one more block to put," Bob said.
"And that's the elephant block," Bobby said.
Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top. But Bob sneezed, and the tower fell. Bobby laughed and laughed. Bobby said, "You always sneeze when the elephant block appears."

다음 글을 읽고 '코끼리 블록(elephant block)'에 대해 추론할 수 있는 것은?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 "Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top"과 "You always sneeze when the elephant block appears"라는 표현으로 보아, 코끼리 블록은 마지막에 올려지는 블록이므로 게임의 끝을 표시하는 데 사용된다고 추론할 수 있다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Bob came back home after a few months. He just lay in bed without talking or moving. Hospitals are often very busy places. After a while, Bobby came into Bob's room with the blocks.

"Bob, it's time to build a tower!"
Bob's mouth made a small smile. Bobby began to build the tower. "Okay, Bob, now the elephant block." Suddenly, Bob made a small sound like sneezing. At that moment, Bobby realized that Bob would recover soon. And Bob did. Slowly, Bob began to talk a little and move his fingers. But he still couldn't walk.

다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장은?
questions.explanation: "Hospitals are often very busy places"는 일반적인 상식을 언급하는 것으로, 이 이야기의 흐름과 직접적인 관련이 없다. 나머지 문장들은 모두 Bob의 회복 과정과 Bobby의 노력에 관한 이야기이다.

questions.question:

When the weather got nice and warm, Bob and Bobby sat side by side. The summer breeze with the smell of happiness was blowing.

Then, Bob stood up very quickly. Bobby smiled and stood in front of Bob. Bob leaned on Bobby' shoulders.

Bobby said, "When I was little, you held my hands and said these words." And Bobby added, "Now one foot."

Like magic, Bob moved one foot.
"Now the other."
And Bob moved the other.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 (A)~(E) 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: "Then, Bob stood up very quickly"는 문맥에 맞지 않는다. Bob이 회복 과정 중에 있으므로 "very slowly"가 적절하다. 실제로 지문의 다른 부분에서 "Then, Bob stood up very slowly"라고 나타난다.

Bob came back home after a (A) [few / little] months. He just lay in bed without talking or moving. After a while, Bobby came into Bob's room with the blocks. "Bob, it's time to build a tower!" And Bob moved the other.

다음 밑줄 친 (A) these words가 다음 글에서 가리키는 내용으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: Bobby가 "제가 어렸을 때, 당신이 제 손을 잡고 (A) 이 말들을 하셨죠."라고 말한 직후, "이제 한 발.", "이제 다른 발."이라고 덧붙인다. 이는 과거 Bob이 Bobby에게 걸음마를 가르칠 때 했던 말을 Bobby가 재현하는 상황이다. 따라서 (A) 'these words'가 가리키는 내용은 '밥이 바비에게 걸음마를 가르칠 때 했던 말'이다.

questions.question:
[지문]
"You taught me how to walk. Do you remember?" Bobby said.

When the weather got nice and warm, Bob and Bobby sat side by side. The summer breeze with the smell of happiness was blowing. ( ① ) Then, Bob stood up very slowly. ( ② ) Bobby smiled and stood in front of Bob. ( ③ ) Bob leaned on Bobby's shoulders. ( ④ ) Bobby said, "When I was little, you held my hands and said these words." And Bobby added, "Now one foot." ( ⑤ ) Like magic, Bob moved one foot. "Now the other." And Bob moved the other.

다음 글의 ①~⑤ 중 글의 흐름상 주어진 문장이 들어갈 위치로 가장 적절한 곳은?
questions.explanation: 주어진 문장은 "제가 걷는 법을 가르쳐 주셨죠. 기억나세요?"라고 Bobby가 말했다는 내용이다. ① 앞 문장은 날씨가 좋아져 Bob과 Bobby가 나란히 앉아 행복한 냄새가 나는 여름 바람을 맞고 있었다는 배경 묘사이다. ① 뒷 문장은 '그때, Bob이 매우 천천히 일어섰다'는 내용이다. 두 사람이 나란히 앉아 있는 상황에서 Bobby가 먼저 말을 걸고, 그 말을 들은 Bob이 일어서는 것이 자연스러우므로 주어진 문장은 ①에 들어가야 한다.
